description: Alert rules engine — defines when email alerts fire, what triggers them, and who receives them.

rules.name: High Rejection Rate
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN claim_status='Rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS rate FROM billing_claims WHERE claim_date >= DATE('now', '-1 day')
rules.subject: ALERT: Billing rejection rate exceeded {rate}% in last 24h
rules.body_template: The claim rejection rate for the last 24 hours is {rate}%. This exceeds the 15% threshold. Immediate review of coding errors is required.

rules.name: Coding Errors Spike
rules.description: New coding errors in last 24 hours
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM billing_claims WHERE has_coding_error = 1 AND created_at >= DATE('now', '-1 day')
rules.subject: ALERT: {count} new coding errors detected in last 24h
rules.body_template: {count} claims with coding errors were submitted in the last 24 hours. Please review the billing queue.

rules.name: Critical Violation Open
rules.description: Any Critical severity finding remains open
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM audit_findings WHERE severity = 'Critical' AND resolution_status = 'Open'
rules.subject: URGENT: {count} Critical compliance violation(s) unresolved
rules.body_template: There are {count} Critical severity compliance violations currently Open. These require immediate action. Please log into the compliance portal to review.

rules.name: HIPAA Violations This Week
rules.description: New HIPAA violations in past 7 days
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM audit_findings WHERE regulation_body = 'HIPAA' AND audit_date >= DATE('now', '-7 days')
rules.subject: ALERT: {count} HIPAA violations recorded this week
rules.body_template: {count} HIPAA violations were recorded in the last 7 days. Review immediately to avoid regulatory penalties.

rules.name: Drugs Expiring in 30 Days
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(SUM(di.current_stock * d.unit_cost), 2) AS value FROM drug_inventory di JOIN drugs d ON di.drug_id = d.drug_id WHERE julianday(di.expiry_date) - julianday('now') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
rules.subject: ALERT: {count} drug batches expiring within 30 days — ₹{value} at risk
rules.body_template: {count} drug batches are expiring within 30 days. Total stock value at risk: ₹{value}. Immediate disposal and reorder action required.

rules.name: Below Reorder Threshold
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM drug_inventory WHERE current_stock < reorder_threshold
rules.subject: ALERT: {count} drug items below reorder threshold
rules.body_template: {count} drug inventory items are below their reorder threshold. Please initiate purchase orders to avoid stockouts.

rules.name: Expired Stock Still Present
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM drug_inventory WHERE julianday(expiry_date) - julianday('now') < 0 AND current_stock > 0
rules.subject: URGENT: {count} expired drug batches still in active inventory
rules.body_template: {count} drug batches have passed their expiry date but still show stock. These must be quarantined and disposed of immediately.

rules.name: Critical SLA Breaches Today
rules.description: Critical SLA breaches in last 24 hours
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM patient_complaints WHERE breach_severity = 'Critical' AND complaint_date >= DATE('now', '-1 day')
rules.subject: ALERT: {count} Critical SLA breach(es) today — patient escalation required
rules.body_template: {count} patient complaints with Critical SLA breaches were filed today. These require immediate escalation to the Clinical Operations Manager.

rules.name: Open Complaints Backlog
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM patient_complaints WHERE resolution_status = 'Open'
rules.subject: ALERT: {count} unresolved patient complaints in queue
rules.body_template: {count} patient complaints remain unresolved. Please review the patient support portal and clear the backlog.

rules.name: Emergency Deliveries Delayed
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM delivery_records WHERE delivery_category = 'Emergency' AND delivery_status = 'Delayed'
rules.subject: URGENT: {count} Emergency medical delivery/deliveries delayed
rules.body_template: {count} emergency medical deliveries are currently delayed. Immediate re-routing or vehicle reassignment is required.

rules.name: SLA Breach Rate High
rules.description: Dispatch SLA breach rate in last 24h
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breached=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS rate FROM delivery_records WHERE DATE(scheduled_datetime) >= DATE('now', '-1 day')
rules.subject: ALERT: Dispatch SLA breach rate is {rate}% in last 24h
rules.body_template: The dispatch SLA breach rate over the last 24 hours is {rate}%, exceeding the 20% threshold. Review route assignments and vehicle availability.

rules.name: No Available Vehicles
rules.description: All vehicles of a critical type are deployed
rules.trigger_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM vehicles WHERE vehicle_type = 'Ambulance' AND available = 1
rules.subject: URGENT: No ambulances currently available
rules.body_template: All ambulances are currently deployed. No emergency dispatch capacity available. Contact partner hospitals immediately.
